recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-12450 unless a future work group decision changes operation GET query parameter encoding.
issue_request: FHIR-12450 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core operations issue asking how to encode a repeating input parameter when an idempotent operation is invoked with HTTP GET. The resolution was to clarify that repeats are represented by repeating the named parameter.
initial_application: The Jira comments record application in svn @11112. Git history maps that to commit 7edc5218da58db5570524fc324f45d3bd66ae767, which added the repeated named parameter paragraph and Observation $stats example to source/operations.html.
additional_context: The current source/operations.html Operation Request section still contains the requested rule and example, and source/documentation.html links the Operations page from the RESTful API documentation. Later edits changed nearby GET-invocation wording and escaping but preserved the repeated-parameter semantics. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting evidence or related final issue that changes this interpretation.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed: the current authoritative source already conveys the approved clarification.
